messages:
Rae (People Ops): Hey team — new manager Jordan Miles starts Mon. I sketched a "compact manager quickstart" (day0 -> week1) that covers tech access + orientation. Please add missing steps. TL;DR below.
Jordan Miles: Thanks! Two quick ones: laptop day0? GitHub org + repo access? also would love a platform buddy.
Avery (IT): If procurement ticket submitted by Thu we can ship overnight for Day0 delivery. For access: I handle Okta/GSuite + GitHub org invites. Please paste your SSH pubkey once invited.
Avery (IT): Proc ticket template (copy/paste):
```
Title: New manager laptop + access - Jordan Miles
Start: 2026-06-07
Team: Eng - Platform
Device: Macbook Pro 14 or existing
Needs: Okta, GSuite, GitHub org (write), AWS staging read, Vault read, KMS view
Manager approver: Diego
```
Diego (Infra): I can buddy wk1 for infra walkthroughs. Day2 I'll demo staging, deploy flow, and how caching/batching configs are tested. If you need a short demo pool, file a request in #eng-infra with expected qps and retention.
Maya (Finance): For expense card: email finance@redwood.com with headcount code and manager approval. Virtual card can be issued same-week once approvals clear.
Rae (People Ops): Compact quickstart checklist: Preboard (3 days out): procurement ticket, headcount note to Finance, Okta invite. Day0 (evening): confirm device tracking # + calendar seats. Day1: 30m 1:1 + access check (Okta/GitHub/AWS), security quickstart, enroll MFA. Day2: infra buddy walkthrough + demo env request if needed. Day3: shadow triage + meet direct reports. Day4: draft 30/60/90 and tag manager for feedback. Day5: kickoff first ownership task + retrospective on week1.
Jordan Miles: I'll paste my SSH pubkey now. Also can someone point me to the manager 30/60/90 template?
Rae (People Ops): Link: <internal-docs/manager-30-60-90> 1 - copy and paste into a doc and tag Diego + your manager. Keep it lean: top 3 outcomes per milestone.
Avery (IT): Okta invite sent to jordan.miles@redwood.com 1 enroll MFA and accept GSuite. GitHub invite pending manager approver. If you don't get invites check spam and let me know.
Jordan Miles: MFA done. GitHub invite appeared, requesting org membership. One more: who sets up access to the Dedicated demo cluster for short demos?
Diego (Infra): File a request in #eng-infra with: purpose, region, replicas, retention hours. For small demo pools (<8h) I can approve fast path if requested before 4pm PT.
ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Manager Orientation - Day 0" invited: jordan.miles@redwood.com
Maya (Finance): Jordan - send me the expected monthly spend for a virtual card and I'll start approvals.
Jordan Miles: Sent the estimate. Thanks all. I'll post my 30/60/90 draft by Friday EOD.
Rae (People Ops): Great. I'll follow up with IT and Procurement to confirm laptop ETA and close out the access checklist. Welcome aboard Jordan! :tada:
